title: VXAce CAPGRAS - When Your Mind Becomes Your Worst Enemy (Completed)

posts.author: Kemonoproject1
posts.body:
SYNOPSIS
Spoiler
It begins with a young woman who recently bought a new house in downtown, where she finds a weird board game named "Finding Treasures". She decides to play it alone. When she plays, strange phenomena starts happening in her house that eventually drives her into endless madness.
CAPGRAS is a story-driven RPG horror game using RPG Maker VX Ace, features classic RPG horror gameplay mechanics and experiences.
Featuring:
Solving puzzles and looking for items to progress the story.
Avoiding various obstacles to survive.
12 Chapters in total - including a secret Chapter.
4-5 hours average long.
Featuring two normal endings and two secret endings.

Spoiler
This is my second attempt of making an RPG Maker Horror Game so flaws and mistakes are unavoidable. English is also not my first language so the translation can be a bit rough at certain parts. However, I hope everyone can enjoy the game as much as possible. Thank you everyone so much!
Note: This is actually my second account on the forum since I have lost my previous one, so if you happen to find another thread of CAPGRAS demo game on this site, it was my account.
